claim: Sprint1: headline 122.1 N·m; grades A-/A-/B+/B+/A-/B+_readiness; objective_met_internal true; E_ll 285 V util@750 0.65; ship_ok false

missed.issue: The purported FE voltage validation rejects its own FE result: the 12-position FE OC fundamental is 0.00201 Wb, while the selected analytical linkage is 0.023119 Wb (11.5x larger) and the torque-implied range is 0.0269–0.0311 Wb. The code labels the analytical value "crosschecked" solely because it lies in an arbitrary 0.008–0.08 Wb sanity band, not because it agrees with FE.
missed.why_it_matters: The claimed 284.652 V line-line EMF and 0.6524 utilization at 750 V are driven by the rejected analytical witness, not by FE. This is an unresolved turns/parallel-path/flux-linkage extraction or reference-frame mismatch, and makes the B+ voltage grade unsupported.
missed.how_to_test: Add a consistency gate requiring FE OC fundamental, torque-implied linkage, and selected linkage to agree within a defined tolerance (for example 20%). This committed case must fail that gate. Then independently verify FEMM linkage scaling for series turns and parallel paths against the analytical linkage before permitting any voltage utilization claim.

missed.issue: The 122.10 N·m headline is promoted despite a factor-of-2.29 disagreement with the dense result at the nominally same -30° command (53.24 N·m mean), while the committed loaded FE point at -30° reports only 31.38 N·m. Relabelling the values as non-interchangeable documents the contradiction but does not establish that the kit sweep is the physically correct operating point.
missed.why_it_matters: A caller consuming `headline_torque_nm` will silently receive a value that exceeds the dense-grid peak (106.87 N·m) and the binding bar still fails (122.10 < 125.2). The 49.36% peak-to-peak ripple also means the headline mean does not demonstrate minimum torque margin; the reported minimum is only 84.97 N·m.
missed.how_to_test: Run both sweep implementations over identical rotor positions, current phasors, RMS/peak convention, turns, parallel paths, and torque sign convention; require pointwise agreement before selecting a headline. Evaluate the duty/binding criterion on minimum or appropriately derated torque, not only mean absolute torque.

missed.issue: `objective_met_internal` is a self-fulfilling grade calculation: grades are mostly hard-coded and `voltage_fw` becomes B+ whenever the selected source string contains "femm", "analytical", or "torque_implied" and the OC EMF is below the 750 V ceiling. It does not require the selected source to be consistent with FE, loaded voltage, Rs/Ld/Lq, current limits, inverter modulation, or a field-weakening schedule.
missed.why_it_matters: The emitted `objective_met_internal: true` and B+ voltage/readiness grades can be interpreted by downstream release dashboards as evidence-based status, even though the file explicitly says those required analyses are absent. The bus ceiling also embeds a particular modulation assumption (`0.612*Vdc`) without binding it to the inverter/ICD.
missed.how_to_test: Create fixtures where FE linkage disagrees with the fallback, loaded voltage exceeds the bus due to Rs/L terms, or inverter modulation capability differs from the assumed ceiling. Assert that voltage_fw is not B+ and objective_met_internal is false in all cases.

generality_concerns: The script hard-codes a 24,000 rpm speed, -30° current angle, 8-pole interpretation, 535/756.6 A fallback currents, 7 OC turns per slot, 1.25° sweep step, and a 125.2 N·m binding bar. It is bespoke to this twin despite schemas and wording implying reusable motor-stack evidence.

The linkage-source selection is not general: its fixed "sane" Wb range silently discards valid small/high-linkage machines and chooses a prior analytical estimate whenever FE exposes a scaling defect.

The DC-to-AC voltage limit assumes a specific PWM/modulation convention and 5% reserve but has no inverter configuration input; utilization therefore changes for SPWM, SVPWM, overmodulation, dead-time derating, and different current-control policies.
review.one_line_summary: The change packages and grades unresolved torque and flux-linkage contradictions as a 122.1 N·m headline and 0.65 voltage-utilization result, so the internal objective cannot be considered met.

arithmetic_errors.where: build_voltage_fe_circle torque-implied λ band (lam_tq_lo/lam_tq_hi) and path_b_voltage_fe_circle_screen.json witnesses
arithmetic_errors.correct: With Iq=I_peak·cos(30°) the implied λ is larger (~0.0311 Wb); with Iq=I_peak it is smaller (~0.0269 Wb). Values are inverted relative to the lo/hi labels (midpoint 0.5·(lo+hi) is still ~0.0290 Wb).
arithmetic_errors.impact: Any reader or downstream check treating the labels as an ordered [low, high] interval is misled; band endpoints are swapped by name only.

reasoning_faults.where: Docstring / Sprint1 claim vs voltage path (build_voltage_fe_circle + grade card)
reasoning_faults.fault: Claims FE voltage circle / multi-witness FE λ, but femm_oc_fundamental_wb≈0.00201 is outside the sane band and rejected; authoritative λ is prior_airgap_B_analytical 0.023119, so E_ll≈284.65 V is not FE-established. Loaded FE single-θ torque≈31 N·m also disagrees with headline≈122 N·m.
reasoning_faults.consequence: voltage_fw B+ and ‘E_ll 285 V util@750 0.65’ are analytical/prior reprise under a PARTIAL_FE status, not a successful FE λ circle.

reasoning_faults.where: Docstring ‘Closes the internal contradictions that keep Map/MTPA and Voltage below B+’ vs map_mtpa_depth grading
reasoning_faults.fault: Map/MTPA is raised to B+ solely because tension is documented; dense@−30° mean≈53.2 N·m vs kit headline≈122.1 N·m (ratio 0.436) is unexplained numerically and left open (‘re-run dense FOC-matched… if mean gap must close’).
reasoning_faults.consequence: objective_met_internal true does not mean contradictions were closed—only that the rubric accepts documentation as B+.

reasoning_faults.fault: Floor check treats self-assigned A−/B+/B+_readiness (including B+_readiness via startswith('B+') and special case) as meeting ‘every EM layer ≥ B+’; release evidence cites ‘internal EM layers ≥ B+’ circularly. Binding bar still fails (122.1/125.2≈0.975) and torque_reliable/duty_torque_screen_ok remain false while kit_case_path_b_story is A−.
reasoning_faults.consequence: Claimed objective_met_internal true is a soft self-grade, not an independent demonstration of readiness physics or dual-bar clear.

review.one_line_summary: Headline/grade/util numbers match artifacts, but FE λ failed sanity and Map gap is only labeled—B+ and objective_met_internal overclaim closure the diff does not establish.
